description: This file defines an interface for building responses and events related to 'ModifyThing' commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested factory interfaces for creating command responses and events, such as 'created', 'modified', and error responses.

classes.name: ModifyThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building command responses and events for ModifyThing commands.

classes.name: ModifyThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command responses such as 'created', 'modified', and error responses.

classes.name: ModifyThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating events triggered by ModifyThing commands, such as 'created' and 'modified'.
